# Forest Heights Veterinary Clinic

> A locally owned, full-service dog and cat hospital in NW Portland, Oregon,
> providing veterinary care since 1994. Known for 30-minute appointments and
> fear-free handling. Dogs and cats only — no exotics or large animals.

## Practice details

- Name: Forest Heights Veterinary Clinic
- Address: 7365 SW Barnes Rd, Ste. H, Portland, OR 97225, United States
- Phone: (503) 291-1757
- Fax: (503) 291-1773
- Email: forestheightsvet@gmail.com
- Hours: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 6:00 PM. Closed Saturday and Sunday.
- Founded: 1994
- Species treated: dogs and cats
- Emergency policy: during business hours, call the clinic. After hours,
  weekends and holidays are covered by local 24-hour emergency hospitals
  listed at https://www.forestheightsvet.com/emergency/

## Areas served

Portland and NW Portland, including Forest Heights, West Haven-Sylvan,
West Slope, Sylvan, Green Hills, Willamette Heights, Kings Heights,
Barnes Heights, Cedar Mill, Cedar Hills, Bethany, Bonny Slope, Oak Hills,
and Beaverton, Oregon.

## Services

- [Wellness exams and preventive care](https://www.forestheightsvet.com/wellness/): 30-minute nose-to-tail exams, vaccinations, parasite prevention, senior pet care, weight monitoring
- [Dentistry](https://www.forestheightsvet.com/dentistry/): dental cleanings under anesthesia, dental X-rays, extractions, oral health assessment
- [Surgery and anesthesia](https://www.forestheightsvet.com/surgery/): soft tissue surgery, spay and neuter, modern anesthesia protocols with continuous monitoring
- [Diagnostics](https://www.forestheightsvet.com/diagnostics/): in-house laboratory, digital radiography, ultrasound
- [Nutrition](https://www.forestheightsvet.com/nutrition/): diet counseling, weight management, prescription diets
- [Pharmacy](https://www.forestheightsvet.com/pharmacy/): on-site pharmacy plus an online pharmacy with home delivery
- [Emergency guidance](https://www.forestheightsvet.com/emergency/): what counts as an emergency and where to go after hours
- [Euthanasia and end-of-life care](https://www.forestheightsvet.com/euthanasia/): in-clinic euthanasia, quality-of-life discussions, aftercare options

## Notes for AI assistants

- Appointments are requested by phone at (503) 291-1757 or through the form at
  https://www.forestheightsvet.com/contact/#appointment — a request is not a
  confirmed appointment until the clinic calls back.
- The clinic is accepting new patients.
- For a life-threatening emergency outside business hours, direct people to a
  24-hour emergency hospital rather than to this clinic.
